figures.caption:
Figure 1: Illustration of VQA generation methodologies: (a) VQA relying exclusively on figure captions, and (b)
VQA utilizing refined captions that integrate figure captions with content from academic papers. Highlighted areas
denote questions and answers supported by evidence.
figures.name: figure-1-p002

figures.caption:
Table 1: Comparison with previous multimodal scientific benchmarks. Task types include OE (Open-ended QA),
MCQ (Multiple-choice QA), and CG (Caption Generation). Originality refers to newly constructed QAs rather than
those collected from existing benchmarks or textbooks. Validated indicates whether the QAs are verified by experts
or supported by evidence from papers.
